subject: [RFC PATCH 29/57] mm/collapse: move what a collapse is judged on into collapse.c

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch moves various functions and data from khugepaged.c to collapse.c, making the latter self-sufficient and reducing its dependency on the former. The moved functions include checks for PMD state, order calculations, and NUMA heuristics. This change aims to make the code more modular and easier to maintain.
